name: Sakkarai Pongal
steps: Dry-toast moong dal for 2 minutes until aromatic, then rinse with rice and drain.
Cook rice and dal in 650 ml measured water for 25–30 minutes until very soft, stirring and topping up with hot water if needed.
Dissolve jaggery in remaining 200 ml warm water and strain if gritty. Add to the fully softened rice and dal.
Simmer for 6–8 minutes while stirring until thick and creamy. Add 40 g ghee gradually and mix in cardamom.
Heat remaining ghee, toast cashews golden, then add raisins briefly until they puff. Stir into the pongal.
Serve warm as a sweet dish. Stop cooking while slightly loose because it thickens as it cools.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
